item.title: TCP vs. UDP in .NET: Speed, Reliability, and the Hidden Cost of Performance
item.description: Choosing between TCP and UDP is crucial for data transport. TCP ensures reliability and ordered delivery, making it ideal for critical applications, while UDP prioritizes speed and low latency, suited for real-time scenarios. Link to article: https://dotnettips.com/2026/07/19/tcp-vs-udp-in-net-speed-reliability-and-the-hidden-cost-of-performance/
